label: HOST-ONLY AUDIO-INFORMATION FORENSIC
question: At what stage between symbolic truth and mixed audio is useful harmonic information lost or temporally distorted?
not_asking: whether harmonic movement is incremental (J3D, INCONCLUSIVE)
whether it has visual value (J3E, INFORMATION_GAIN)
whether a model is needed (deliberately deferred until this forensic returns)

object_under_test.frontend: host_chroma12 EXACTLY AS IT IS. It is the object under test, not an implementation detail to be swapped.
characteristics_documented: each FFT bin assigned to the nearest equal-tempered MIDI pitch class
sqrt then divide by a frozen A4 reference amplitude
L1 normalisation applied later, only for movement comparison

Q0_ANALYTICAL_FRONTEND_AUDIT.status: computed from the frontend constants alone, before any corpus metric. Arithmetic, not a result.

Q0a_pitch_class_resolution.reading: every pitch below MIDI 49 (138.6 Hz) occupies less than one FFT bin per semitone and therefore CANNOT be pitch-class resolved by this frontend by construction. J3C measured this corpus's lowest sounding voice at a mean of MIDI 37.2 - the entire bass register sits inside the unresolvable zone.

Q0b_single_note_harmonic_leakage.method: fold a 1/k-amplitude harmonic series through the same nearest-pitch-class rule and normalise
Q0b_single_note_harmonic_leakage.reading: ONE note already deposits a major-triad-plus-seventh pattern: 85% root, 9.3% fifth, 3.2% major third. This is a systematic bias present in every frame, not noise.

Q0_ANALYTICAL_FRONTEND_AUDIT.why_this_is_in_the_preregistration: these two facts create a strong prior for a frontend-dominant outcome. Stating them BEFORE the ladder runs means the ladder can still falsify them - if individual stems track the oracle well despite this arithmetic, the prior was wrong.

stem_sum_reconstructs_the_mix.requirement: RMS(sum of stems - mix) / RMS(mix) <= 1% on EVERY track
stem_sum_reconstructs_the_mix.measured: 0.100% to 0.301%, 20/20 tracks pass, best scalar gain 1.0000
stem_sum_reconstructs_the_mix.why_blocking: if the stems did not sum to the mix, S1 -> S2 -> S3 would not be the same signal at three stages and no attribution would be valid
stem_sum_reconstructs_the_mix.note: macOS AppleDouble '._' files must be filtered from the stem glob

unrendered_oracle_mass_HYPOTHESIS_FALSIF.hypothesis_tested: part of J3D's ceiling is an artefact because all_src.mid contains instruments whose audio was never rendered, which chroma could not possibly see
unrendered_oracle_mass_HYPOTHESIS_FALSIF.measurement: pitched note-duration mass in stems missing from disk = 186.0 s of 43,829.4 s total
unrendered_oracle_mass_HYPOTHESIS_FALSIF.verdict: FALSIFIED. Unrendered instruments cannot explain the J3D gap. Eliminated before pre-registering the ladder.

fast_chroma_must_reproduce_the_frontend.requirement: the vectorised power-chroma used for the ladder must reproduce host_chroma12 to within 1e-5 after sqrt/reference/clip, asserted in code on real audio
fast_chroma_must_reproduce_the_frontend.why: the ladder needs per-pitch-class POWER (host_chroma12 emits a clipped square root). Instrumenting the same maths is permitted; substituting different maths is not.

signal_ladder.S0: symbolic oracle - J3D pitch-class state and M_tv, unchanged
signal_ladder.S1: each pitched stem separately: host_chroma12 on that stem, paired with that stem's OWN MIDI file
signal_ladder.S1_aggregate: per-pitch-class POWER summed across pitched stems, then the frontend's sqrt/ref/clip. This is the cross-term-free mixture and is identical to Q3 condition A.
signal_ladder.S2: waveform sum of the pitched stems only, then host_chroma12
signal_ladder.S3: the original full mixture including percussion, then host_chroma12 - the J3D condition
signal_ladder.percussion: excluded from the LABEL and from S1/S2 exactly as J3D did; retained in S3

Q1_renderer_stem_timing.question: does rendered audio from an individual pitched stem lead or lag its own MIDI state transition?
Q1_renderer_stem_timing.estimator: half-rise crossing of the pitch-class state distance at isolated note onsets, the SAME estimator J3D-C1 declared primary
Q1_renderer_stem_timing.isolated_onset_definition: a note onset with no other onset in that stem within +/- 8 hops
Q1_renderer_stem_timing.only_this_measured_offset_may_be_applied: in Q2's aligned view. A lag optimised against R^2 would be circular and is forbidden.

metrics_at_each_rung: grouped 5-fold out-of-fold R^2 of symbolic M_tv from chroma movement
top-5% oracle-event recall in the top 20% of chroma movement
Q2_ladder_degradation.primary_question: where does the large drop occur?

Q3_nonlinear_mixing.A: aggregate per-pitch-class POWER across individual stems after analysis (no cross terms)
Q3_nonlinear_mixing.B: run the frontend on the waveform sum (cross terms present)
Q3_nonlinear_mixing.why_they_differ: |sum x|^2 = sum |x|^2 + cross terms. A minus B isolates exactly the interference cross terms.
Q3_nonlinear_mixing.threshold: R^2(A) - R^2(B) >= 0.15 implicates MIXTURE_INTERFERENCE; both < 0.50 implicates RENDERER_OR_FRONTEND

family_breakdown.taxonomy: existing MIDI program numbers only. No product instrument ontology is invented.
family_breakdown.status: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. This is not the instrument-intelligence lane.

error_typology.sample: the 200 strongest missed symbolic harmonic events (top-5% oracle movement with chroma response below its threshold), bounded and mechanically classified. No hand labelling.
error_typology.purpose: identify what a better CONVENTIONAL frontend would actually need to fix

outcome_taxonomy_in_precedence_order.condition: per-stem half-rise offset is systematic (median in [-1.5,-0.5] or [0.5,1.5] hops with IQR <= 1.0 and consistent sign across most families) AND S1 R^2 at the measured aligned lag >= 0.70 while at zero lag < 0.50
S1 R^2 < 0.50 even at the measured aligned lag AND the spread across families is material (max-family minus min-family R^2 >= 0.20)
no single rung accounts for at least half the recoverable degradation

do_not_force_a_single_label: if the ladder shows several causes, MULTIFACTOR is the honest answer.
forbidden_in_this_job: relabelling J3D-A or J3D-C1 on the strength of J3E
product_grammar_wording: J3E's L6/L7 result is preserved as HOST_EVIDENCE_OF_PRODUCT_HARMONIC_GRAMMAR_GAP. The actual device and LGP path have not been tested and no claim is made that the hardware cannot express harmony.
